- INV-2027-0628 (EUR 7,125) — VAT reverse-charge (EU B2B)
- INV-2027-0630 (EUR 3,250) — VAT charged (non-recoverable)

I attached: Redwood_statement_Jun2027.pdf (applies mapping and bank trace).

If anything here looks off to you, Alex, let me know and well escalate quickly. If all good, reply with a one-line confirmation and well mark the invoices paid.
